# GDG Windsor DevFest 2026

> Official website for GDG Windsor DevFest 2026, a developer conference in Windsor, Ontario, Canada.

## Event Information

- Event: GDG Windsor DevFest 2026
- Date: November 21, 2026
- Location: Windsor, Ontario, Canada
- Website: https://wedevfest.com/

## Important Pages

- [Home](https://wedevfest.com/): Event overview, speakers, schedule, and registration.
- [About](https://wedevfest.com/about): Information about the event.
- [Venue](https://wedevfest.com/venue): Venue information.

## About the Event

GDG Windsor DevFest 2026 brings together developers, technology enthusiasts, and industry professionals to learn, connect, and share knowledge.
